name: High Executor Derrington
summary: At the Bulwark, High Executor Derrington directs the Forsaken vanguard against threats from the Western Plaguelands. He sends seasoned champions toward contested ruins such as Andorhal and Scholomance.

sections.title: Commander at the Threshold
sections.body: High Executor Derrington commands the Bulwark’s barricades, where soldiers cross from Tirisfal Glades into the Western Plaguelands. He has little patience for political maneuvering in the Undercity. To him, the front lines are a test of survival. So he orders Horde soldiers and sellswords to scout plague-ridden territory and blunt enemy incursions before they reach Tirisfal.

sections.title: A War on Two Fronts
sections.body: The Bulwark faces the Scourge in Andorhal and the Scarlet Crusade farther north. Scourge forces spread corruption through cauldrons in the countryside. The Crusade’s zealous fanatics contest northern fortifications and skirmish relentlessly with Forsaken patrols. Derrington coordinates sharp counterattacks, sabotage against Scarlet lines, and the systematic disruption of Scourge cauldron fields to protect the eastern border.

faq.answer: High Executor Derrington commands the Forsaken at the Bulwark, the military outpost between Tirisfal Glades and the Western Plaguelands. He coordinates the Horde’s eastward push against the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade.
Derrington is stationed at the Bulwark, a fortified choke point at Tirisfal Glades’ eastern edge along the road into the Western Plaguelands.

faq.q: What is Derrington's objective at the Bulwark?
faq.answer: Derrington seeks to preserve Forsaken survival through strong defense against the Scourge and strikes into the Western Plaguelands. He sends adventurers to scout Andorhal, disable plague cauldrons, and disrupt Scarlet Crusade operations.

faq.q: Does Derrington care about Undercity politics?
faq.answer: No. Derrington has little patience for Undercity politicians and schemers. On the front lines, survival must be fought for every day.

faq.q: What major threats does Derrington send soldiers against?
faq.answer: Derrington sends soldiers against the Scourge in Andorhal, the dark necromancers inside Scholomance, and nearby Scarlet Crusade garrisons threatening the Horde’s eastern supply routes.

faq.q: Why is the Bulwark so heavily fortified?
faq.answer: The Bulwark guards the passage between Tirisfal Glades and the Plaguelands’ active combat zones. Its forces hold the pass to keep Scourge swarms or Scarlet Crusade forces from sweeping toward the Undercity.

angles.text: For Horde travelers in Tirisfal, Derrington directs forces into the dangerous conflicts of the Western Plaguelands.
As Forsaken, you see Derrington uphold the military strength that guards reclaimed lands against the Scourge and Scarlet fanaticism.
As a warrior, you see Derrington value martial skill and battlefield results over court scheming.
